basis: Repetitive proline-rich cell wall protein; seed-coat expression pattern (Wyatt et al. 1992 Plant Cell; localization not re-read here). Not in Zhang 2025 de novo lists. Raised medium -> high 2026-10-20: top sn7 (seed-coat epidermis) marker, pct 0.78 vs 0.14, LCM SC-EPD-specific glob/hrt (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS), first single-cell support and independent of Wyatt 1992.

bHLH42/TT8 proanthocyanidin regulator; snRNA DE of SC_epidermis at GS, CS, EMS (pct 0.72-0.83 vs 0.18-0.29) (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell). Broad in pigmented seed coat. Raised low -> medium 2026-10-20: marker of all four Pelletier seed-coat epidermis clusters sn3/7/13/20 (pct 0.68-0.95 vs 0.26-0.29) (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); broad background in both datasets.

TTG2 ortholog (seed-coat tannin/mucilage WRKY); SC-EPD-specific TF in LCM glob (Fig S6, Fig 3 conserved with Arabidopsis); high in sn3/13/20 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 SC epidermis. Broad background in nuclei (pct2 0.26-0.30).

MYB5 ortholog (Arabidopsis seed-coat development); SC-EPD/palisade-specific TF at all stages in LCM and sn13 pct 0.63 vs 0.10 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS). UniProt hit is a non-reference entry (A0A368UI80, named MYB58).
GLABRA2 ortholog; SC-EPD-specific TF (glob) and em palisade (Fig S6); sn13/sn3 pct 0.85/0.63 vs 0.20 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS).

Seed-coat peroxidase localized to hourglass (hypodermal) cells (Gijzen et al. 1997 Plant J). Zhang 2025 has no hourglass label: the gene is DE in SC_vascular_parenchyma (CS) and SC_vasculature (EMS), so hourglass cells are probably merged there. Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS: marker of sn1 and sn6b (pct 0.30-0.38 vs 0.08, LCM cotSC-OI), not of the weak 'hourglass' cluster sn5b; hourglass placement still rests on Gijzen 1997 only.
KANADI2-like; sn5b ('hourglass') pct 0.46 vs 0.06 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Dataset S4). sn5b assignment is weak (34 markers, hourglass layer not continuous at cot stage). Hypothesis only.

Seed-coat sugar exporter selected during domestication (Wang et al. 2020 Natl Sci Rev); seed-coat parenchyma by Visium (Zhang 2025 Fig 2D). UniProt calls it SWEET24. Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS: Dataset S4 lists it as a marker of sn17 only (pct 0.58 vs 0.22; LCM hrtSC-II, emSC-PY), Fig 5C shows sn0/sn14/sn17; parenchyma placement not contradicted.

Seed-coat sugar exporter (Wang et al. 2020 Natl Sci Rev). Conflict: Zhang 2025 finds it in the CS Visium 'End micropylar' cluster and late peripheral endosperm. Do not use alone. UniProt calls it SWEET39.

Seed-coat subtilisin SCS1, in situ/promoter localized to thick-walled parenchyma (Batchelor et al. 2000 Planta); top sn0 marker pct 0.82 vs 0.13 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Fig 5C); Zhang et al. 2025 Cell SC parenchyma. Thick-walled (inner) parenchyma. Collation 2026-10-20: medium, not high (review): broad in Zhang 2025 SC parenchyma (pct2 0.68-0.89 at CS/EMS).

Seed coat BURP protein, thin- and thick-walled parenchyma (Batchelor et al. 2002 Planta); very high but broad in snRNA (sn0/5a/8/17, pct2 0.55) (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 SC parenchyma. Use as positive, not exclusive, marker. Collation 2026-10-20: low, not medium (review): broad in both datasets (pct2 0.55 Pelletier, 0.88 Zhang EMS).

MUM2 beta-galactosidase ortholog (seed-coat mucilage); sn14 (SC-II) pct 0.52 vs 0.01, LCM SC-II-specific hrt/cot (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 SC inner integument. Two-study agreement. Conflict: Zhang 2025 lists it as SC inner integument at GS/HS but Emb epidermis at CS.

sn14 pct 0.44 vs 0.01, LCM SC-II-specific glob-cot (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 SC inner integument snRNA and Visium SC inner parenchyma. Conflict: Zhang 2025 lists it as SC inner integument at GS/HS but Emb epidermis at CS.

NAC087 ortholog (developmental PCD regulator); top inner-integument-specific TF in LCM at glob, hrt and cot (Fig S6) and highest in sn14 (Dataset S3) (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 SC inner integument. Conflict: Zhang 2025 lists it as SC inner integument at GS/HS but Emb epidermis at CS.

TT16/ABS ortholog, required for endothelium differentiation in Arabidopsis (Nesi et al. 2002 Plant Cell); LCM SC-ENT-specific TF at hrt/cot (Fig S6), highest in sn9 (Dataset S3) (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS). Zhang 2025 'SC unknown' only. Homology support: AtTT16 endothelium function (characterized_markers.tsv).
AGL6 MADS; sn9 (SC-ENT) pct 0.51 vs 0.01, LCM cot SC-ENT-specific TF (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 SC endothelium snRNA, Visium SC inner parenchyma.

CYP86B1 suberin/cutin omega-hydroxylase; sn9 pct 0.77 vs 0.05 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 SC endothelium snRNA, Visium inner parenchyma. Fits the cuticularized endothelium. Collation 2026-10-20: kept low (review: medium); no LCM SC-ENT flag in Dataset S4 and both snRNA endothelium labels rest on Goldberg/Harada LCM correlation, so the two-study agreement is not validation.
Lipoxygenase; sn9 pct 0.52 vs 0.01, LCM SC-ENT-specific glob-cot (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 SC endothelium + Visium inner parenchyma.

JACKDAW C2H2 ortholog; ENT-specific TF in LCM at all three stages (Fig S6), sn9 pct 0.32 vs 0.03 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 SC endothelium. Collation 2026-10-20: raised to medium (review: low); LCM ENT-specific (hrt, cot in Dataset S4; all stages in Fig S6) plus endothelium cluster in both snRNA datasets.

Flavonoid 3'-hydroxylase (T locus, hilum and pubescence colour); snRNA DE of SC_hillum_parenchyma at HS but broad (pct 0.89 vs 0.42) (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell). Conflict (2026-10-20): in Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS it marks seed-coat epidermis clusters sn3/4/7/13 (pct 0.82-0.94 vs 0.27), not the hilum cluster sn16. Kept low; not hilum-specific.
source: 10.1016/j.cell.2024.10.050; Toda et al. 2002 Genetics 163:295 (as cited in Zhang 2025 Table S2); 10.1073/pnas.2416987121

basis: Hilum-specific TF in LCM at glob, hrt, cot (Fig S6) and sn16 marker pct 0.25 vs 0.02 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 SC hilum vasculature. Hilum, not parenchyma-specific.

SWEET clade-III sucrose exporter (ortholog, not LDO, of AtSWEET11, phloem parenchyma); snRNA DE of SC_phloem at GS-CS and SC_vasculature at EMS, Visium 'SC vasculature' at HS. Conflict: Visium 'SC outer parenchyma' at CS. UniProt calls it SWEET21. Raised medium -> high 2026-10-20: sn6b (phloem parenchyma/vasculature) marker, pct 0.56 vs 0.11, named SWEET13 by TAIR best hit (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); validated by Visium in one study and cluster-specific in another. Zhang's CS Visium outer-parenchyma signal still stands.
Cell-wall GRP localized to vascular tissue by tissue printing (Ye & Varner 1991 Plant Cell); maps to sn6b (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Fig 5C, S11B), weak in nuclei; Zhang 2025 Visium SC vasculature.
Phloem identity MYB-CC, LDO of Arabidopsis APL per Zhang 2025 Table S2, but UniProt names it PHR27: confirm orthology. No soybean expression evidence in Zhang 2025 de novo lists.

S1-group bZIP9 (phloem-specific in Arabidopsis); snRNA DE of SC_phloem at GS, HS, CS and SC_vasculature at EMS (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell). Raised low -> medium 2026-10-20: sn6a/sn6b seed-coat phloem marker (pct 0.61 vs 0.04 in sn6b) (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS), second independent study.

Callose synthase 7 ortholog (Arabidopsis sieve-plate callose, phloem-specific); sn6a pct 0.47 vs 0.05, LCM SC-OI-specific (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 SC phloem. sn6a GO = callose deposition in sieve plate.
bZIP9 paralog; sn6a/6b and sn1 (pct2 0.12-0.15) (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 SC phloem/vasculature and Visium SC vasculature.

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (IRX1/CESA8 LDO); snRNA DE of SC_xylem at all four stages (log2FC ~7), but Visium puts it in 'SC tracheid bar' (CS) and 'SC parenchyma1 & epidermis' (HS): marks secondary-wall cells, incl. tracheid bar. Listed twice under two names in Zhang 2025 Table S2. Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS: marker of sn17 (pct 0.35 vs 0.005), a mixed seed-coat cluster (hourglass/epidermis/hilum genes) the authors leave unassigned; consistent with secondary-wall cells such as the tracheid bar.
Xylem cysteine protease of tracheary-element PCD (LDO of AtXCP2); literature list only, no soybean expression evidence in Zhang 2025.
PXY/TDR procambial receptor kinase ortholog (LDO); snRNA DE of Em_vasculature at EMS (pct 0.38 vs 0.015) (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell).

Ortholog (not LDO) of an Arabidopsis chalazal-endosperm LCM gene (Belmonte et al. 2013 PNAS); not in any Zhang 2025 soybean de novo list. Weakest row in the table. Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS (Fig S6) names this ID MYB98 and lists it as an LCM ES-specific TF at hrt/cot, but its LCM endosperm is not split into regions, so this does not support the chalazal call; weak in cot snRNA. Not raised.
Ortholog of an Arabidopsis micropylar-endosperm LCM gene (Belmonte et al. 2013 PNAS); in soybean only weak snRNA Endosperm DE at EMS (Zhang 2025), no sub-region evidence.

ZHOUPI ortholog (Arabidopsis ESR endosperm bHLH controlling endosperm breakdown, Yang et al. 2008 Development); Visium de novo marker of peripheral endosperm at CS (pct 0.55 vs 0.02) (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell) and sn11 marker (pct 0.48 vs 0.02, LCM cot/em ES-specific) in the HCR-validated embryo-surrounding + peripheral endosperm cluster (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS). Moved 2026-10-20 from Endosperm/characterized_enriched/low: two independent studies place it in peripheral (+ESR) endosperm, not micropylar as Arabidopsis predicts; ESR and peripheral are merged in sn11.
LITTLE ZIPPER (function unrelated to endosperm); Visium de novo marker of peripheral endosperm at CS only (pct 0.57 vs 0.03; 55 um spots, not cell resolution) (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell).
Serine carboxypeptidase-like; top sn11 marker pct 0.95 vs 0.07, LCM ES-specific (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Dataset S4); Zhang et al. 2025 Cell snRNA 'End peripheral'. Two-study agreement.
sn11 pct 0.77 vs 0.02, LCM ES-specific (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Dataset S4); Zhang et al. 2025 Cell 'End peripheral'. Candidate for HCR probe 'sn11_02G' (INFERRED, probe ID not published).
sn11 pct 0.82 vs 0.02, LCM ES-specific (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Dataset S4); Zhang et al. 2025 Cell Visium 'End peripheral'. Candidate for HCR probe 'sn11_12G' (INFERRED).

Sucrose exporter from endosperm to early embryo; endosperm-expressed, knockout aborts seeds (Wang et al. 2019 Plant Physiol); endosperm by Visium (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell Fig 2D). UniProt names this protein SWEET10: compare by Glyma ID. Main text typo 'Glyma05G12200'. Also sn11 marker (pct 0.71 vs 0.10, LCM emES-specific) in Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS.

Paralog of GmSWEET15a, endosperm sucrose export (Wang et al. 2019 Plant Physiol); not among Zhang 2025 snRNA or spatial de novo markers, so check enrichment in data. Raised medium -> high 2026-10-20: sn11 marker (pct 0.85 vs 0.10, LCM ES-specific hrt-em) in the HCR-validated embryo-surrounding + peripheral endosperm cluster (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS), second independent study after Wang 2019. Biased to peripheral/ESR endosperm within the endosperm.

HD-ZIP IV; marker of all three endosperm clusters sn10/11/12 (pct 0.74-0.96 vs 0.12), LCM ES-specific TF at hrt/cot (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Dataset S4, Fig S6); Zhang et al. 2025 Cell Endosperm/End peripheral.

AGL62 ortholog (Arabidopsis endosperm cellularization regulator, Kang et al. 2008 Plant Cell); LCM ES-specific TF at hrt (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Fig S6); not detected in cot-stage snRNA (post-cellularization); Zhang et al. 2025 Visium End chalazal. Early stages only. Homology support: AtAGL62 syncytial-endosperm function (characterized_markers.tsv).
Top sn10 (aleurone, HCR-validated cluster) marker, pct 0.94 vs 0.09; LCM emES-specific (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Dataset S4). Uncharacterized; storage-protein-like, ambient risk.

sn10 marker pct 0.75 vs 0.03, LCM emES-specific (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Dataset S4). Strongest chr08 sn10 marker, so a candidate for the HCR probe 'sn10_08G' (aleurone in situ, Fig 5B), but the paper never gives the probe's Glyma ID: INFERRED, not verified.

AINTEGUMENTA-LIKE 7 (AP2) ortholog; sn10 pct 0.39 vs 0.004, LCM ES-specific hrt-em (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Dataset S4); Zhang et al. 2025 Cell snRNA 'End micropylar'/Endosperm marker, so aleurone vs micropylar conflict.

WOX8/9 (STIMPY-LIKE) basal-lineage TF family; among top suspensor-specific TFs in LCM SUS at glob, hrt and cot (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Fig S6). No suspensor snRNA cluster. Not in Zhang 2025 a4 expressed gene list: confirm Wm82.a4 ID before use. Homology support: AtWOX8/WOX9 basal-lineage function (Breuninger et al. 2008 Dev Cell). Wm82.a2 ID absent from the Zhang 2025 a4 tables: confirm the a4 ID before use.
Suspensor-specific TF in LCM SUS at glob, hrt and cot (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Fig S6); essentially undetected in cot snRNA.

LCM SUS-specific TF at hrt/cot (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Fig S6), BUT Zhang et al. 2025 Cell marks it in SC hilum vasculature (snRNA) and tracheid bar (Visium): conflicting, use only with excludes on seed coat.

Kunitz trypsin inhibitor; in situ: globular-embryo region, then embryo axis from heart stage, outer cotyledon cells in maturation (Perez-Grau and Goldberg 1989 Plant Cell). Embryo by Visium and snRNA DE (Em_initials HS, Em_proper_initials CS) in Zhang 2025. Two independent studies, so raised to high. Also sn2 (embryo proper) marker, pct 0.28 vs 0.03, LCM cot-EP-specific (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS).

CYP78A/KLUH-family P450 (seed size); in 91-97% of embryo-proper nuclei vs 8-12% elsewhere at GS/HS, and Visium de novo 'Emb initial' at HS (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell); sn2/sn18 embryo marker at cot stage (pct 0.44-0.49 vs 0.13-0.15) (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS). Raised medium -> high 2026-10-20 (validated spatially in one study, cluster-specific in a second); embryo-wide, strongest GS/HS.
Seed maturation/LEA protein; snRNA DE of the GS embryo proper only (pct 0.33 vs 0.006) (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell).

LEAFY COTYLEDON1 master regulator of seed maturation (Pelletier et al. 2017 PNAS); expressed in embryo and endosperm, so it separates filial tissue from seed coat, not types within the embryo. Not in Zhang 2025 de novo lists.

PROTODERMAL FACTOR1 ortholog (AT2G42840, LDO), epidermis-specific in Arabidopsis; Visium de novo 'Emb epidermis' at CS and EMS (pct 0.88) (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell). Embryo epidermis only: the seed coat epidermis is a different (maternal) layer. Raised medium -> high 2026-10-20: sn18 (embryo protoderm) marker, pct 0.46 vs 0.04 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS), second independent study.

GPI-anchored lipid transfer protein for cuticular wax export (Arabidopsis LTPG1); snRNA DE of Em_epidermis at CS (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell). Raised low -> medium 2026-10-20: sn18 protoderm marker, pct 0.55 vs 0.04; also LCM SUS-specific hrt/cot (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS). Marks suspensor outer layer too.

PROTODERMAL FACTOR1 ortholog; sn18 (embryo epidermis) pct 0.42 vs 0.009 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Dataset S4); Zhang et al. 2025 Cell Emb epidermis snRNA and Visium. Two-study agreement. Collation 2026-10-20: high (Zhang Visium Emb epidermis CS pct 0.86 + Pelletier cluster-specific). Also Zhang GS/HS Em_initials (whole embryo proper).

CER1 alkane-forming wax enzyme ortholog; sn18 pct 0.46 vs 0.01 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang et al. 2025 Cell Emb epidermis snRNA + Visium. Paralog Glyma.03G101700 marks seed-coat epidermis instead. Collation 2026-10-20: medium (enrichment-only low, +1 for Zhang Visium agreement).

Non-specific LTP; sn18 pct 0.60 vs 0.02; LCM SUS (all stages) and em cotyledon abaxial epidermis specific (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang et al. 2025 Cell Emb epidermis. Marks suspensor and embryo epidermis.
SPEECHLESS ortholog, stomatal lineage entry; Visium de novo 'Emb epidermis' at CS (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell). Stomatal-lineage specificity not resolved in this dataset.

SPEECHLESS ortholog; embryo-epidermis expression and RNAi loss of meristemoids (Danzer et al. 2015 Plant Physiol); EMB11 module, sn18 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS Fig 5C, 8); Zhang et al. 2025 Visium Emb epidermis. Draft has paralog Glyma.06G125500.

Kunitz trypsin inhibitor KTi1/2 class; in situ in outer cotyledon perimeter cells from early maturation, absent from the axis and early embryo (Perez-Grau and Goldberg 1989 Plant Cell). Not in Zhang 2025 de novo lists. Stage-restricted (maturation).

Beta-conglycinin alpha' storage protein; beta-conglycinin mRNA accumulates in a wave across cotyledon cells in maturation by in situ (Perez-Grau and Goldberg 1989 Plant Cell; probe gene class, locus assignment from Zhang 2025 Table S2). Stage-restricted; ambient storage mRNA likely in all droplets.

Glycinin G4 11S storage globulin of cotyledon storage cells; Zhang 2025 Table S2 cites only a CRISPR mutagenesis paper (Li et al. 2019 BMC Res Notes), no cell-level localization. Stage-restricted; ambient mRNA risk.

YABBY1/FIL ortholog, abaxial cotyledon domain (literature, Fig 5C ref Siegfried 1999 Arabidopsis); LCM cot EP-specific TF; sn2/sn18 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS); Zhang 2025 Emb initials. Abaxial domain, not all cotyledon cells.
SHOOTMERISTEMLESS ortholog (soybean homeobox SBH1), SAM maintenance; Visium de novo 'Emb axis' at CS and EMS (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell). Spots are coarser than the SAM.
STM paralog; snRNA DE of the HS embryo proper (Em_initials, pct 0.12) (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell). Not a spatial marker (corrects the review).
Class I KNOX (KNAT6-like); Visium de novo 'Emb axis' at CS (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell). Also expected at organ boundaries.

Class I KNOX (BP/KNAT1, LDO of maize KN1 per Zhang 2025 Table S2); Visium de novo 'Emb axis' CS and EMS. ID is Wm82.a4-only: not in UniProt or NCBI Gene, so check it exists in the dataset's annotation.

PLETHORA root stem-cell niche AP2 ortholog (Arabidopsis: Aida et al. 2004 Cell); embryo root pole by Visium (Zhang 2025 Fig 2D) and HS 'Emb initial' de novo. Conflict: also a Visium de novo marker of the EMS 'SC tracheid bar' spot cluster.

CDC20/Fizzy APC/C activator of G2/M; snRNA DE of Dividing_cell at all four stages (Emb dividing cell at CS) (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell). State, not type. Also sn15 marker (CDC20.1, pct 0.81 vs 0.08) (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS), a G2/M cluster the paper labels embryo proper.
CDC20/Fizzy paralog, G2/M; snRNA DE of Dividing_cell at all four stages (Zhang et al. 2025 Cell). State, not type. Also sn15 marker (pct 0.62 vs 0.05) (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS).
G2/M cyclin; top sn15 marker pct 0.87 vs 0.13 (Pelletier et al. 2025 PNAS; sn15 is labeled 'EP' in the paper but is a G2/M cluster); Zhang et al. 2025 Cell Dividing cell. Two-study agreement.
